% Invented fixture: overlays, dim-not-hide. Item specs, an inline
% \uncover, and \pause — the PDF handout gets one page per step with
% pending content dimmed in place; HTML keeps one slide with step data.
% \visible keeps its argument's place and ships none of it off its steps.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{slides}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{Reveal in order}
\begin{itemize}
\item<1-> Always here.
\item<2-> Second beat.
\item<3-> Third beat.
\end{itemize}
\uncover<3>{A closing line for the last step.}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Paused}
Before the pause.

\pause
After the pause.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Kept in place}
Before the reveal \visible<2>{a phrase kept in place} and after it.
\end{frame}

\end{document}
